real_defects_found.finding: V1/V2 CaseFile assumes a single subject_id, which is inadequate for real cross-ref and source-vs-runtime audits.
real_defects_found.repair: Add backwards-compatible MultiSubjectCaseFile with explicit SubjectBinding and CrossSubjectClaim.

real_defects_found.finding: A live GitHub file read bound only to a mutable branch name can mix branch-head and file-content frontiers if the ref moves during the read.
real_defects_found.repair: GitHub live adapter reads branch head, fetches file by exact commit SHA, then rereads branch and marks evidence stale if the ref moved.

real_defects_found.finding: Hand-maintained aggregate report counts drifted from the actual case corpus before commit.
real_defects_found.repair: Derive verdict counts from case files and reject report/corpus mismatch.

claim_ceiling: Real public-project source audits performed by the same development agent. Demonstrates application of Voss semantics to live GitHub evidence; not independent qualification.
